hero.description: I will make the most delicious cakes for you of any type, size and design, for any celebration or occasion. And also if you simply want to treat yourself or your loved ones to an amazing cake or dessert.

about.title:
Products and
ingredients
about.description: Great importance is not only the appearance of the cake and its taste, but first of all the products from which it is made. In my production, I use only high-quality natural products and ingredients that do not contain trans fats and palm oil.

snowflake.title:
Sponge cake
SNOWFLAKE
snowflake.description: Sponge cakes — light and airy. Sponge forms the basis of most cakes.

angelTears.title:
Cottage cheese cake
ANGEL TEARS
angelTears.description: Cottage cheese cakes — healthy and delicate. Often combined with berry filling.

napoleon.title:
Puff pastry cake
NAPOLEON
napoleon.description: Puff pastry cakes — an interesting combination of the finest dough and cream. The most popular representative of this type is Napoleon.

linz.title:
Shortbread cake
LINZ
linz.description: Shortbread cakes — quite dense and at the same time crumbly. The dough is based on butter, flour and sugar.
